title: Generative Refinement Learning for Temporal Interpolation in Scientific Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.36751v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computationally expensive simulations and real-world observations often provide data at a lower temporal resolution than downstream tasks require. Averaging observations at fixed grid points can introduce errors, and motion estimates alone do not determine how the physical field values change. In this work, we study whether learning to correct a simple numerical interpolation improves the reconstruction of intermediate scientific fields. Our model, interpolative FLow EXpert (iFLEX), first estimates the missing field by taking a weighted average of the two observations at each grid point, giving more weight to the observation closer to the requested time. During training, subtracting this estimate from an observed intermediate field gives the residual that a conditional diffusion model learns to generate. Both observations condition the model, together with the target time, the interval between observations, and available physical param

translated_title: 科学机器学习中时间插值的生成式精炼学习
translated_abstract: 计算代价高昂的仿真与真实世界观测所提供的数据，其时间分辨率往往低于下游任务的需求。在固定网格点上对观测值取平均可能引入误差，而仅凭运动估计也无法确定物理场数值如何随时间变化。本工作研究了通过学习来修正简单的数值插值，能否改进中间科学场的重建。作者提出的模型——插值流专家模型iFLEX（interpolative FLow EXpert）——首先在每个网格点上对两次观测取加权平均来估计缺失场，其中权重更偏向于距离所请求时刻更近的那次观测。在训练过程中，将这一估计值从观测到的中间场中减去得到残差，并由一个条件扩散模型学习生成该残差。两次观测连同目标时间、观测间隔以及可用的物理参数共同作为模型的条件输入。
tldr: 提出iFLEX模型，用条件扩散模型学习修正基于时间加权平均的简单插值所产生的残差，从而在低时间分辨率数据下更准确地重建中间科学场。
en_tdlr: Proposes iFLEX, which uses a conditional diffusion model to learn residuals that correct a simple time-weighted-average interpolation, enabling more accurate reconstruction of intermediate scientific fields from low temporal resolution data.
